taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Market-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104 | 2.86 | 2.86
2 | 186 | 2.38 | 5.24
3 | 266 | 24.7 | 29.9
4 | 327 | 24.6 | 54.6
5 | 219 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Market-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAK-type (progressively increasing resistivity from Layer 1 to Layer 4, followed by a resistivity drop into Layer 5)
Aquifer depth: 29.9 m – 54.6 m (Layer 4, 327 Ω·m, thick coarse sand/gravel horizon), with a possible secondary saturated zone continuing below 54.6 m in Layer 5

Recommendation: Target the main borehole screen between 30 m and 55 m depth, corresponding to the thick, high-resistivity Layer 4 sand unit, which is the most promising aquifer zone; case off the upper, lower-resistivity clayey layers (0–29.9 m) to prevent sand/clay influx, and consider deepening slightly past 55 m to test the underlying Layer 5 for additional yield if required.
